_comment: Threats (docs/ADVENTURES.md §5.1, §8.3; world/threats.py): kinds of danger with a will behind them, made from what the history left. budget: how many may be stirring or active at once, by world size. near_hero: at most `untaken` of them within `tiles` of the hero that the hero has not taken on. start: at least `tier_one` tier-1 threats within `tiles` of a starting town (a week's walk is about 56 tiles). stage_days: how long a scheme's stage lasts, by tier. sign_lead_days: a stage's first sign comes at least this long before its effects. target_level: the party level a finale is measured for, by tier. tier_by_danger: [least danger of the home, tier]. wake: a dormant threat's weekly chance to stir by itself. emptied: a doomed settlement keeps `floor` of its people and comes back after `rebuild_days`. hunters: the history's beast-hunting heroes go on hunting (a weekly chance, more by fame). interlude_stages: the most stages a threat moves while nobody plays.
